maj-18.exo: Illusions, deceptions, fears and uncertainties. It points to a phase of passage in which things are not what they seem.
maj-18.psy: The unconscious with its dreams and fears; the territory in which unacknowledged emotions take shape.
maj-18.ini: Path 29 from Netzach to Malkuth, the letter Qoph (the back of the head, 100) and Pisces, the mutable water of Jupiter in which Venus is exalted: the dark threshold before dawn. The scarab Khephra pushes the sun through the waters of the night.
maj-18.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals deception, confusion, irrational fears, escapes and dependences.
maj-18.up: Cross the uncertainty without letting fear rule you; what is hidden will come to light in its own time.
maj-18.rev: Illusions beginning to dissolve and truths surfacing; or fears that take root because they are avoided.
maj-18.love: Doubts, jealousy, projections; clarity and a check of the facts are needed.
maj-18.work: Unclear situations, misleading information; be careful with decisions and paperwork.
maj-18.spirit: Crossing the dark night of the soul, with the certainty that the sun is already rising.
maj-18.crowley: Crowley's Moon is an unsettling threshold: two black towers and two figures of Anubis with jackals guard the path, while the scarab beneath the waters carries the sun toward morning.

maj-19.exo: Success, joy, vitality, clarity. It points to a bright period, recognition, health and good relationships.
maj-19.psy: Fully self-aware consciousness, the joy of existing without shame; innocence regained after maturity.
maj-19.ini: Path 30 from Hod to Yesod, the letter Resh (the head, 200) and the Sun: the light that illuminates the intellect and the foundation. It is the Lord of the new Aeon, solar consciousness restored to humanity.
maj-19.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals vanity, arrogance, blind optimism, exhibitionism.
maj-19.up: Everything becomes clearer: success, joy and transparency. A favourable moment in almost every field.
maj-19.rev: Joy that is clouded or inflated; the success is there but goes unrecognised, or turns into self-satisfaction.
maj-19.love: Happiness, warmth, a sunny and sincere relationship; a bright period for the couple and for new acquaintances.
maj-19.work: Success, visibility, creative energy and recognition of merit.
maj-19.spirit: The light of the Self illuminating everything without distinction.
maj-19.crowley: Crowley's Sun announces the freedom of the new Aeon: two winged children dance on a green hill ringed by a wall, a limit humanity is called to overcome, beneath a sun surrounded by the twelve signs.

maj-20.exo: Renewal, final decisions, awakening. It points to a turning point that closes one chapter and opens another, often with sudden clarity.
maj-20.psy: The call to a new consciousness of yourself; the ability to take leave of the past and be reborn with a different outlook.
maj-20.ini: Path 31 from Hod to Malkuth, the letter Shin (the tooth, 300) and Fire together with Spirit: the fire that descends to transform matter. It is the advent of the Aeon of Horus, the Crowned and Conquering Child.
maj-20.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals postponed decisions, hasty judgements, fear of the new, or fanaticism.
maj-20.up: A new phase begins: answer the call and make the decision you have been putting off.
maj-20.rev: An awakening postponed, or a fear of being judged; the change remains inevitable all the same.
maj-20.love: A deep renewal of the relationship, or a final decision about the bond.
maj-20.work: A professional turning point, a new course, the need to update yourself to the times.
maj-20.spirit: The Aeon of Horus: the consciousness of the divine child, freedom and True Will.
maj-20.crowley: Crowley replaces Judgement with the Aeon, inspired by the Stele of Revelation: Nuit arched across the background, the winged globe of Hadit, and Horus in the double form of a child and a seated god.

maj-21.exo: Completion, fulfilment, final success. It points to the end of a cycle, the reaching of a goal and sometimes to journeys or a widening of horizons.
maj-21.psy: The integrated wholeness of the person; the peace of someone who has given form to their potential and can recognise themselves as whole.
maj-21.ini: Path 32 from Yesod to Malkuth, the letter Tau (the cross, the seal, 400) and at once Saturn and Earth: the last path, where manifestation is completed and from which the return begins. The seal of the Great Work is also the door of the ascent.
maj-21.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals stagnation, inertia, works left unfinished, Saturnine rigidity.
maj-21.up: Completion and integration: the cycle closes successfully and the next one is prepared.
maj-21.rev: Something remains unfinished or too heavy; it needs to be completed before you begin anything else.
maj-21.love: A full, mature union, a sense of shared completeness; sometimes a bond that opens out to the world or to a journey together.
maj-21.work: Goals reached, projects concluded, recognition of a long path.
maj-21.spirit: The Great Work accomplished: matter revealed as the dance of spirit.
maj-21.crowley: Crowley's Universe is a maiden dancing with the serpent, turning the spiral of energy inside an ellipse of seventy-two sections; the Kerubim stand at the four corners, and at the centre the pattern of the elements.
